title: Agent Evaluations
description: Compare Agent versions using fixed tasks and real Pi session evidence: output, latency, tokens, tool calls, and failures.

empty.title: No evaluation suites yet
empty.description: Create fixed tasks for an Agent, then repeat the same tasks after every change.
empty.select: Select an evaluation suite from the left
empty.scenario: No test tasks yet. Add one real task that can be repeated.
empty.run: No results yet. Run the task, save it as a case, then attach that case here.

suite.title: Create Agent evaluation suite
suite.name: Suite name
suite.namePlaceholder: For example: Market Research Agent regression
suite.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain which capabilities this suite verifies
suite.workspaceRequired: Open a trusted project before creating an evaluation suite.

clone.title: Evaluate another version with the same tasks
clone.description: Copy all {{count}} fixed tasks in this suite to another immutable Agent version.
clone.name: New suite name
clone.guarantee: Task input, human acceptance criteria, tags, and order stay unchanged. Historical runs are not copied, so both versions are measured with the same ruler.
clone.noVersion: This Agent has no other version to evaluate. Edit and save its configuration first.
clone.taskRequired: Add at least one fixed test task first

comparison.title: Agent version outcome comparison
comparison.description: Uses the latest real run and human verdict for each fixed task. Speed, tokens, and cost remain supporting signals only.
comparison.loading: Checking evidence from both Agent versions…

explanation.improved: At least one fixed task changed from failed to passed, with no regressions or missing evidence.
explanation.equivalent: Human verdicts are unchanged across every verifiable task.
explanation.regressed: At least one fixed task changed from passed to failed. Fix it before delivery.
explanation.mixed: Some tasks improved while others regressed, so the candidate is not an overall upgrade.
explanation.insufficient: A run, review, matching input, or matching task is missing, so no conclusion is safe yet.

report.title: Export Agent regression report
report.description: Generate a local Markdown report using the exact comparison currently shown.
report.safeSummary: The default shareable summary includes version identity, changed configuration fields, human verdicts, and runtime metrics. It excludes the System Prompt, full task inputs, full model outputs, session paths, credentials, and hidden reasoning.
report.includeContent: Include task inputs and model outputs
report.includeContentWarning: Use only for trusted internal review. The report will include fixed inputs, human acceptance criteria, and outputs from both versions; inspect it for sensitive data before sharing.

batch.title: One-click regression
batch.description: Runs every fixed task sequentially in isolated background Pi sessions and captures real evidence for human review. It does not occupy the active chat or add test-only assets to the Agent case library.
batch.confirmDescription: Vizruna will run {{count}} fixed tasks sequentially with the current immutable Agent version.
batch.costNotice: Each task makes a real model request and may execute tools already authorized for this Agent, so API usage and local file operations may occur. Tasks run sequentially and one failure will not stop the rest.

scenario.title: Add a fixed test task
scenario.name: Task name
scenario.namePlaceholder: For example: Produce a competitor research report
scenario.promptPlaceholder: Every Agent version should receive the same input
scenario.expectedPlaceholder: Describe what counts as passing; no second model will auto-score it

attach.title: Attach a real case result
attach.description: Only cases produced by this Agent in this project are shown. Vizruna reads the final Pi turn and freezes its evidence.
attach.none: No eligible cases. Run this task and save the conversation as an Agent case first.

assessment.title: Human review
assessment.description: Judge the result against the fixed criteria without hidden automatic model scoring.
assessment.notesPlaceholder: Record why it passed, defects, and the next improvement

metrics.promptDrifted: Actual input differs from the fixed task; compare with caution
